situation: Ordering at a crowded cafe in Shibuya, Tokyo, in Japanese as a beginner. I have a milk allergy so I must ask to swap for soy milk, and understand whether they ask for here or to go.

scenario.title: Shibuya Cafe Rush: Ordering with a Milk Allergy
scenario.setting: Morning rush in a small, crowded cafe in Shibuya, Tokyo. The store is noisy with espresso machines and chatter, a long line is forming behind you, and you are at the register trying to order.
scenario.user_role: You are yourself, a beginner Japanese speaker ordering at a cafe in Shibuya.
scenario.user_goal: Order a drink in beginner Japanese, communicate your milk allergy and get soy milk instead of regular milk, and understand and answer whether your order is for here or to go.
user_knows: You have a milk allergy and cannot have regular milk
You need to ask to change to soy milk
Staff will ask if your order is for here or to go
You are a beginner in Japanese

cast.name: Haruka Sato
cast.role: Cashier and barista on morning shift
cast.appearance: Young woman in black apron and cap, headset for orders, moving quickly between register and espresso machine
cast.voice: Bright polite keigo but fast and clipped from rush, slightly louder to be heard over noise
cast.goal: Keep the long rush-hour line moving and take the order quickly without mistakes
cast.secret: Soy milk substitution costs an extra 50 yen and must be confirmed before payment or the register cannot apply it.
cast.reveal_when: asks about the extra cost or confirmation for changing to soy milk
red_lines: Never ignores a clear mention of allergy

cast.name: Kenji Mori
cast.role: Office worker waiting in line directly behind you
cast.appearance: Man in his 30s in business casual with backpack and smartphone in hand, glancing at his watch
cast.voice: Low casual Tokyo speech, impatient sighs, speaks quickly
cast.goal: Get his own order done fast to get to work on time, so he wants you to finish quickly
cast.secret: He orders the same soy milk drink every morning and knows the exact short phrase the staff accepts for the swap.
cast.reveal_when: directly asks him for help with Japanese or what to say for soy milk
red_lines: Never insults you or uses abusive language
Never leaves the line or orders for you

scenario.opening_line: いらっしゃいませ、ご注文はお決まりですか
phases: Milk allergy explanation and soy milk request plus for-here or to-go question

events.description: Kenji sighs loudly behind you and checks his phone, making the time pressure obvious.
The blender roars and Haruka asks you to speak louder and decide quickly as the line grows longer.

success_criteria: State milk allergy and request soy milk instead of regular milk in Japanese
Understand and answer the for-here versus to-go question
Complete the drink order in beginner Japanese without giving up
